headline: Tarapur Transformers releases AGM voting results
hook: Tarapur Transformers concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: Tarapur Transformers Limited has filed its scrutinizer's report following the Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The company has officially submitted the voting results to the NSE. This filing confirms the completion of the mandatory corporate governance process for the fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
